query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "total_cost_usd!", COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "total_input_tokens!", COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "total_output_tokens!", COALESCE(SUM(cache_creation_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "total_cache_creation_tokens!", COALESCE(SUM(cache_read_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "total_cache_read_tokens!", COUNT(*) AS "record_count!" FROM usage_records WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND created_at >= $2 AND created_at < $3
